markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (88%)** · Ambiguous: InSitu vs Invasive · Careful review
Invasive carcinoma (6% risk) remains in the 90% conformal set [F1], and all four margins are positive [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 88%, Invasive 6%, Benign 5%, Normal 0% | Strongly favors InSitu |
| Conformal set | InSitu, Invasive (90% coverage) | Cannot exclude invasion |
| Reliability / OOD | 96% reliability, OOD 1.0, 12 tiles [F6] | Passes QC despite stain |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Independent models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 InSitu (81%–89% similarity) [F5] | Unanimous neighbor match |

## Tissue evidence
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 0, 6, 8) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score lowers invasive risk [F2] · Weak
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 10) · context · Scarce infiltrate raises invasive score [F3] · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 7, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical [F4], but 0/20 spot check is unreliable · Unreliable
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 4, 5, 6) · ↑ invasive · High score, but 3/20 spot check is unreliable · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions drops risk more than random (95% CI excludes 0).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion CI includes 0); leans on unreliable normal lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20), and mitoses (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Stromal invasion exists in regions 6, 1, or 3, matching invasive contrast case BACH_0212 (80% similarity).
- Severity-3 stain degradation on this simulated frozen section masks invasion (frozen-section reliability AUROC 70%).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 6, 1, 3**: Check highest-risk tiles (63%, 38%, 19% risk) for stromal invasion, especially region 3.
2. **Regions 0, 6, 8**: Verify atypical cells stay duct-confined and exclude microinvasion.
3. **Regions 7, 11**: Check unreliable normal-lobule regions and all four positive margins (108–323 µm; stains blocked).
